name: MedCTA source-derived OCR harness development pilot
selection: seed 20261108; OCR present, GoogleSearch absent; image paths unique; labels not used in membership selection; patient and original source grouping unavailable
candidate: one source-trajectory-derived general OCR usage policy generated before development; at most 1200 chars; no retune
control: same controller, image, OCR access, call budget and final-answer contract without learned policy
tool: local Tesseract OCR computed from current image only, exposed once if requested; evidence not automatically medical truth
primary: strict normalized exact whitelist match and exact blacklist avoidance, conservative proxy; report paired gain/loss and all failures; no clinical claim
secondary: OCR invocation/completion, current-image evidence exposure, time/calls, outputs for private adjudication
confirmation: none; held-out validation and confirmation labels not read
limits: 25 total calls; <=2 calls per case-arm; 2 hour original deadline; own allocated files below 100 MB; shared data read-only; no GPU
public_boundary: no raw images, questions, answers, trajectories, case IDs, credentials or individual outputs
